q: 按门店看销售额（不含税）
sql: SELECT s.code AS "门店编码", s.name AS "门店名称", ROUND(SUM(ol.qty * ol.price) / 1.13, 2) AS "销售额（不含税）" FROM biz_order AS o JOIN store AS s ON s.id = o.store_id JOIN order_line AS ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND NOT o.is_test AND NOT s.is_test GROUP BY s.code, s.name ORDER BY "销售额（不含税）" DESC
text:

想看哪个时间范围、按什么维度？
why: 反问：想看哪个时间范围、按什么维度？

sql:
SELECT 
    s.big_region AS "大区",
    SUM(o.amount) AS "销售额（含税）"
FROM 
    biz_order o
JOIN 
    store s ON s.id = o.store_id
WHERE 
    NOT o.is_test
    AND NOT s.is_test
    AND o.status = 'shipped'
GROUP BY 
    s.big_region
ORDER BY 
    "销售额（含税）" DESC
